purpose: Test whether O0's frozen 13-feature information can be exploited better by nonlinear model capacity.
single_controlled_change: Replace O0 StandardScaler + LogisticRegression estimator with a validation-tuned HistGradientBoostingClassifier; keep the exact O0 13-feature matrix unchanged.
